resolved.title: UPPER 大写函数
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The UPPER Function[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]UPPER [/b]function converts all letters in the specified string to uppercase. 
The [b]LOWER [/b]function converts the string to lowercase.

[s0l0!-header][b]The following SQL query selects all [i]LastNames [/i]as uppercase:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="sql" codeId="3053"]SELECT FirstName, [b]UPPER(LastName)[/b] AS LastName 
FROM employees;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2822" width="100%"]
[note]If there are characters in the string that are not letters, this function will have no effect on them.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The UPPER Function[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]UPPER [/b]function converts all letters in the specified string to uppercase. 
The [b]LOWER [/b]function converts the string to lowercase.

[s0l0!-header][b]The following SQL query selects all [i]LastNames [/i]as uppercase:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="sql" codeId="3053"]SELECT FirstName, [b]UPPER(LastName)[/b] AS LastName 
FROM employees;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2822" width="100%"]
[note]If there are characters in the string that are not letters, this function will have no effect on them.[/note]

content.text:
**UPPER**函数将指定字符串中的所有字母转换为大写。
**LOWER**函数将字符串转换为小写字母。

面的SQL查询将列**LastNames**转为大写字母：
content.text_html:
The **UPPER **function converts all letters in the specified string to uppercase. The **LOWER **function converts the string to lowercase.

**The following SQL query selects all LastNames as uppercase:

**UPPER **函数将指定字符串中的所有字母转换为大写。 LOWER **函数将字符串转换为小写字母。

**下面的SQL查询选择所有LastNames 为大写字母：

content.content:
SELECT FirstName, UPPER(LastName) AS LastName 
FROM employees;

resolved.title: SQRT 和 AVG 函数
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]SQRT and AVG[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]SQRT[/b] function returns the square root of given value in the argument.

[s0l0!-header][b]Let's calculate the square root of each Salary:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="sql" codeId="3054"]SELECT Salary, [b]SQRT(Salary)[/b] 
FROM employees;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2823" width="100%"]
Similarly, the [b]AVG[/b] function returns the average value of a numeric column: [code format="sql" codeId="3055"]SELECT [b]AVG(Salary) [/b]FROM employees;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2824" width="100%"]
[note]Another way to do the SQRT is to use POWER with the 1/2 exponent. However, SQRT seems to work faster than POWER in this case.[/note]
resolved.description_en:

resolved.title: SUM 求和函数
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The SUM function[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]SUM [/b]function is used to calculate the sum for a column's values.
  
For example, to get the sum of all of the salaries in the employees table, our SQL query would look like this: [code format="sql" codeId="3056"]SELECT [b]SUM(Salary)[/b] FROM employees;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2825" width="100%"]
[note]The sum of all of the employees' salaries is 31000.[/note]

resolved.title: 学期成绩平均分查询
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设有一个同学**Sam**，大学毕业后，得到了每学期每个课程的成绩单。
数据在表**sam_grades**中，如下图：

![](/content/assets/7dce1e9a4a4f8b469c31.jpeg)

列字段备注:
- `subject`: 课程
- `score`: 分数
- `semester`: 学期，如第1学期，第2学期

写一个查询，输出同学**Sam**在**第一学**期的考试成绩的**平均分数**。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]AVG[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given the following table [b]sam_grades[/b], which shows Sam’s exam scores.[img id="4517" width="100%"]
Write a query to output the [b]average[/b] of Sam's exam scores for [b]the first semester[/b].
[note]Use the [b]AVG()[/b] function![/note]

code_templates.solution_code: SELECT AVG(score) FROM sam_grades WHERE semester = 1
code_templates.prepend_code:
CREATE TABLE sam_grades (
  subject VARCHAR(128),
  teacher VARCHAR(128),
  score VARCHAR(128),
  semester VARCHAR(128)
);

INSERT INTO sam_grades (subject,teacher,score,semester)
VALUES
('Math','Mr Smith',100,1),
('Chemistry','Mr Gibson',95,2),
('Physics','Ms Anderson',97,1),
('Geography','Mrs Gray',88,1),
('English','Mr Gross',90,2);
